source: Source: Audemars Piguet; Watches by SJX

slides.label: The material
slides.headline: Bulk metallic glass
slides.body: AP used it for the bezel and centre bracelet links, set against brushed titanium.

slides.label: Why “glass”
slides.headline: No crystal structure
slides.body: Cooled almost instantly, the palladium-based alloy sets without crystals, just like glass.

slides.label: The dial
slides.headline: Smoked burgundy
slides.body: Bright red at the centre, fading to near-black at the edge, with pink gold markers.
